description: It would make online industrial approvals investor-friendly; 162 types of approvals on offer
body_lead: It would make online industrial approvals investor-friendly; 162 types of approvals on offer Hyderabad: The government is set to introduce artificial intelligence (AI)-powered TG-iPASS 2.0, upgrading its existing single-window online industrial clearance system to make approvals faster, smarter and hassle-free for investors and to introduce a slew of new features. Sources said the TG-iPASS 2.0 will be expanded from the existing 69 types of approvals to 162, by adding 93 new services.
